title: Component Part 2.4: functional Label + TextInput + TextArea (text controls)
description: Continue the functional v2 component set on the registry-driven framework from Part 2.3 (task 1233, commit e334044 — CONTROL_REGISTRY in packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts: per-control buildMarks + authorClassBody on a shared base, ExportAssets + registerClass DoInitAction, generic setComponentParam live params, manual bbox-click since bundled Ruffle doesn't dispatch button-mode onPress to registerClass'd clips). Add three standard, commonly-used text controls via the SAME registry (no per-control if-chains): (1) mx.controls.Label — static display text (reuse DefineEditText skin), honors author 'text'/'autoSize'; (2) mx.controls.TextInput — single-line EDITABLE EditText (selectable/editable flags set), reflects author 'text', exposes getText/setText, dispatches a change on edit; (3) mx.controls.TextArea — multi-line editable EditText (wordWrap/multiline). VERIFY ground truth first (catalog packages/core/src/model/components.ts already lists these + params; confirm not already done). VERIFY (no real-Flash fixture): structural unit tests (decode own SWF — each emits class DoInitAction + EditText skin with correct editable/multiline flags + registerClass) AND a Ruffle oracle for rendered text/visibility (note: headless keyboard EDITING is hard to oracle — assert the editable EditText is present + author text renders; keyboard-entry can be structural-only, state that explicitly). Build+tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). Update docs/13. SCOPE: components.ts (registry entries), component-place.test.ts, component-oracle.spec.ts.
